entry: 推荐方案为TemplateSubset.adoption内嵌强类型记录；采用后保存于ProjectState.template_adoptions。原adoption-material.json仅作完整源归档/说明，不作为Host执行指令。采用事务读取精确模板文件，不按任意asset JSON或文件名猜义务。

rules.effect: Phases remain actual10/45/5 and5/20/5 seconds with explicit pause_resume, phase resources and whole duration=None. phase_material is archived provenance, not a second work-time authority.

Bind actual source task/target and source worker keys; route_refs empty is unresolved. After real route selection insert/reuse an exact Task step in Board01 processing predecessors, target role explicitly maps Board01. Existing common readiness marker reuse executes30s preparation once for same frozen target/task/configuration before first use; later same marker adds no work or material. Never invent a Route/Product.

Source IDs index exact four requirements/roles/capacity1person/calendar0..300000. resource_id=None requires actual resource selection/create with actual definition/calendar; rewrite device/phase/job/route bindings atomically. Explicit existing-resource differences remain visible in preview, not implicit overwrite.

Closed ImportedProfessionalClaim has mode, exact consumers, source archive RFC6901 pointer, required/missing field names. It has no result/outcome/ack/accepted flags. Raw claim including accepted_scope remains imported statement only; declared_process does not become a trusted acknowledgment. Actual calculated/software modes still require the existing complete professional binding gates.

Preserve PASS/PASS as two string TypedValues. item_or_ancestor/match_kind=None is an unresolved target choice, never a global future-item PASS. Actual InspectionPreset must match known actual item/ancestor and exact inspection ModuleRef; qualify its ID by adoption.id + local preset id. Private compiled per-device quality lookup explicitly resolves frozen local result_ref via this record to the qualified Scenario preset, without rewriting immutable definition/version. Missing/null/exhausted follows existing UNKNOWN cursor rules.

Only BoardFinish01 transform output selects released; input fields must beNone and Packing01 existing required_quality=[released]. Apply in ALG-06 unique actual output-slot creation at last effective phase completion. Import/start/cancel/intermediate phase cannot apply. Blocked destination keeps job holder/resources; retries transfer same already-released slot. No mass item_type change, inventory/ack/order creation or industrial quality claim.

Typed five stock rows/demand2/location/time retained. Product/BOM/Route refs and original initial-quality choices areNone; seed remainsNone. Only explicit new-scenario seed choice with actual referenced inputs materializes current ScenarioInput/InitialItem/Order/ProductionTask. Existing-project default adds no inventory/demand.

Typed kind/object/source-pointer/required-fields describes unresolved actual inputs. Site height is Hall/Device height; footprint is Device.footprint_m; clearance comes from explicit SiteEnvelope.clearance_m, not a invented device size. Source spec strings remain unresolved actual specification refs. Re-read actual fields per purpose; deleting Issue text does not fulfill these requirements. No sitePass fromnull/empty.

rules.consumer: Exact immutable ModuleRefs + current fields + complete source archive FileRef
rules.effect: Seven existing local definitions/files remain; changed BoardFinish is a separate0.2.0 derivative and the new typed template candidate0.3.0. Typed directives drive consumers; inactive aliases/legacy assumptions stay read-only source data. FileRef stays contained/listed/copied on Project save/reopen/export. No generic plugin map, second inventory or new Commands.

transaction: ImportDraft.proposed_data already supports ProjectState/Module/Definition. ProjectState.template_adoptions retains exact mapped obligation data on accepted draft; TemplateInstantiation.subset carries it in existing apply_commands. Validate same proposed Project/Scenario copy and file closure before revision publish. Wrong type/ref/conflict/cancel -> zero commit; missing user inputs can save a typed draft, cannot silently dispatch.
remap: Complete layout map + explicit compatible item-type/actual-resource map rewrites typed preparation target/before IDs, claim consumers, preset consumer, deferred stock/destination, missing-input object refs and RoleBindings.targets. Preserve worker source keys and source archive pointers. Qualify source-local preset IDs via unique adoption.id in the private per-device projection; exact ModuleRefs never auto-upgrade.
